 Advertisement Thousands fight for chance to see Noah Kahan at Fenway Park in 'the ticket war'
 Advertisement Updated: 11:10 PM EST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Initha Selvakumar Thousands fight for chance to see Noah Kahan at Fenway Park in 'the ticket war'
 Updated: 11:10 PM EST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Initha Selvakumar MANCHESTER, N.H. — Thousands of fans attempted to purchase presale tickets to see New England native Noah Kahan during his six shows at Fenway Park next summer. 
 News 9 spoke to New Hampshire residents who tried to buy tickets. Some described the experience of purchasing tickets as a nightmare, and said the added shows didn't help them. 
 Advertisement Fans who did secure a spot said it took them hours. 
 "We were two hours in and still nothing happened. We had to go leave to get our kids from school, so we gave up hope," said Kyra Patch of Somersworth. "By the time I got home, I just hopped on in hopes that maybe by the grace of god they were going to be something, and I ended up scoring two tickets."
 Others said the experience left them discouraged and they do not know if they will try again. 
 "After my experience today with the MLB website, I just feel very discouraged, and I have no idea if we're going to end up with tickets or not," Candace Dewey, of Wakefield, said. 
 General sale for the tickets starts on Thursday. 
 Noah Kahan was born in Vermont and went to high school in Hanover.
